message: Sometimes I wonder about the span of time in which we expect students to overcome error--semester--versus how much time it must take for the information to be grasped and internalized , much less conveyed in their writing.  And I'm speaking about developmental students who are traditional.  They are having to learn how to be college students, writers and grammarians (well "grammarian" is a stretch).  I've grown to realize that just because a student barely squeaks by doesn't mean that he will never get it--it may simply take more time than are planned in a semester.
